data.title: Alliance Entertainment: Strong Q1 Results and Vinyl Momentum Support Buy Rating; $8 Price Target Unchanged
data.description:
Tom Forte, an analyst from Maxim Group, reiterated the Buy rating on Alliance Entertainment Holding. The associated price target remains the same with $8.00.

Tom Forte gave his rating based on several factors, led by Alliance Entertainment’s better-than-expected first-quarter results and broad strength across its physical-media categories. Revenue, gross margin, adjusted EBITDA, and earnings per share all exceeded expectations, while sales excluding gaming rose strongly as vinyl and CDs continued to gain traction. The sustained expansion of vinyl and the emerging CD recovery suggest that consumer demand for tangible music products remains a meaningful growth driver.

He also viewed the planned Grand Theft Auto VI release, alongside a related vinyl launch, as a potential catalyst for gaming and music sales, despite the quarter’s gaming weakness. Improving free cash flow, lower debt, and his view that the company can finance operations internally reduce balance-sheet risk and support continued investment. Forte therefore maintained a Buy rating and an unchanged $8 price target, based on discounted-cash-flow valuation and potential multiple expansion.

Forte covers the Consumer Cyclical sector, focusing on stocks such as Fossil Group, Perfect Moment Ltd., and Interactive Strength Inc. According to TipRanks, Forte has an average return of 2.6% and a 42.25% success rate on recommended stocks.

data.title: Newsmax’s Strong Q3 Execution Supports Buy Rating; $20 Price Target Unchanged
data.description:
Analyst Tom Forte of Maxim Group reiterated a Buy rating on Newsmax Inc. Class B, retaining the price target of $20.00.

Tom Forte gave his rating based on Newsmax’s strong third-quarter execution, with revenue and adjusted EBITDA exceeding both his estimates and consensus even after excluding a one-time benefit. He was particularly encouraged by affiliate-fee revenue, which grew sharply as a share of sales through pricing gains, new distribution agreements, and international expansion. The company also ended the quarter with substantial liquidity, no debt, and positive free cash flow, supporting continued investment and growth.
Forte also viewed management’s maintained underlying outlook and higher reported guidance as evidence of business momentum, while updating near-term estimates and retaining longer-term projections. Although overall reach declined, Newsmax preserved a strong cable-news ranking, attractive engagement among viewers aged 35–64, and double-digit social-follower growth. His valuation framework supports a $20 12-month price target, unchanged from $20, making the stock’s growth prospects and operating strength consistent with a Buy rating.

According to TipRanks, Forte is a 3-star analyst with an average return of 2.6% and a 42.25% success rate. Forte covers the Consumer Cyclical sector, focusing on stocks such as Fossil Group, Amazon, and Jakks Pacific.
